title: Woźny Joanna
name: Woźny Joanna
description: composer, born on 27 July 1973 in Zabrze, in 1992-98 she studied philosophy at the Silesian University in Katowice. In 1996-2003 she studied composing with Beat Furrer at the Universität für Musik und Darstellende Kunst in Graz, graduating with honours. Among the awards she has won are: Musikförderungspreis der Stadt Graz (young composers award) (2001), Honorary prize by the Kunstuniversität Graz (2004), SKE Publicity Preis (2010), and Erste Bank Kompositionspreis (2010). Her works have been performed by RSO Radiosymphonieorchester Wien, DSO Deutsches Symphonie-Orchester Berlin, Munich Radio Orchestra, Polish National Radio Symphony Orchestra in Katowice, Klangforum Wien, Ensemble Mosaik, ensemble recherche, Ensemble ascolta, Ensemble Courage, PluralEnsemble, Ensemble PHACE, die reihe, conducted by Brad Lubman, Enno Poppe, and Lukas Vis, among others. Joanna Woźny's music has been presented at such festivals as Wien Modern, Ultraschall Berlin, Warsaw Autumn, Musica Polonica Nova, Klangspuren Schwaz, Musikprotokoll Graz, Forum Neuer Musik in Cologe, Festival Eclat Stuttgart, ISCM World New Music Days 2013. She lives in Austria. Updated: June 2014 Read more on website of the composer's publisher: www.editionjulianeklein.de
